initial_url.description: The URL or filename to load automatically on startup. Empty string disables auto-load.

html_mode.description: HTML parsing strictness. Valid values: fussy-html, clean-html, valid-html, broken-html, ignore-broken.

use_dark_background.description: If true, forces the use of the dark background color scheme.

use_bright_background.description: If true, forces the use of the bright background color scheme. Mutually exclusive with use_dark_background in practice.

use_wget_for_http.description: If true, uses the wget(1) external command to retrieve HTTP pages instead of the built-in handler.

ignore_proxy.description: If true, ignores HTTP_PROXY and http_proxy environment variables when using the built-in HTTP handler.

anchor_offset_top.description: If true, places anchors at the second line of the screen when jumping to them.

use_cursor_keys.description: If true, uses arrow keys for cursor movement instead of vi-like keys (^H/^J/^K/^L).

assume_xterm.description: If true, assumes the terminal supports xterm-like attribute handling for bright backgrounds.

assume_console.description: If true, assumes the terminal does not need the xterm workaround (e.g. Linux console).

no_force_colors.description: If true, uses the terminal's default text colors instead of forcing netrik's default (white on black) even with dark background.

warn_unknown.description: If true, issues warnings when unknown HTML elements or attributes are encountered.

no_term_width.description: If true, renders lines wider than the screen width for very long words instead of breaking them.

debug.description: If true, shows intermediate layouting stages before displaying the page.
